integrity: Analytic infinite-sample proof and exact finite-size identity, accompanied by deterministic finite rational checks and seeded computations; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent locations on the continuous circle only; conditional expected social cost and ratio rather than realized lottery draws; a non-elementary Gaussian supremum limit; not a theorem about expected approximation ratios or nonuniform populations.
title: Exact mean advantage and a common non-Gaussian limit for circular facility lotteries
